item.title: 🟠 Veeam, Terraform MCP, Django Patch Critical Flaws, Led by CVSS 10.0 Cross-Tenant Bug
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and user awareness training.

item.title: 🟠 New OVSwrap Linux Kernel Flaw Lets Local Users Gain Root via Open vSwitch
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
A memory corruption flaw in the Linux kernel's Open vSwitch datapath gives ordinary local users a path to root on a broad set of default-configured distributions, and a public exploit ships with pre-built records for roughly 800 kernel builds. Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 4h ago

item.title: 🟠 Critical Gitea Flaw Let Unauthenticated Attackers Read Server Files via Org-Mode Markup
item.description:
Why this matters: Hospitality system impact — check guest-facing services and PMS/POS status.
An unauthenticated attacker can read any file the service account can access on Gitea, the self-hosted Git platform, in versions 1.22.1 through 1.27.0. No login, no repository write access. A public repository and crafted Org-mode markup are enough. The flaw is fixed in Gitea 1.27.1.
